role_goal: Establish a fresh empirical baseline by preparing the pinned checkout and executing the supplied reproducer without changing the implementation.
use_when: The checkout is not ready or no fresh baseline execution result exists.
Existing baseline evidence is missing or stale after an observable change to the execution inputs or environment.
The reported behavior still needs to be confirmed with the supplied reproducer.
avoid_when: A fresh baseline result already describes the current unmodified checkout.
A candidate patch is applied and the unresolved need is validation of that candidate.
The requested work is diagnosis, source modification, promotion, or finalization rather than reproduction.
supported_inputs: Executor-visible test contract and designated test targets.
Pinned repository metadata and public task artifacts.
Observable checkout and baseline freshness state.
expected_outputs: A fresh baseline execution record with outcome, return code, and concrete output.

role_goal: Analyze concrete execution or repair evidence, explain the most likely failure mechanism, and record an evidence-grounded diagnosis without modifying source code.
use_when: A fresh baseline or candidate execution exposes a failure whose mechanism is not yet adequately explained.
Observable patch rejection or validation evidence contradicts or makes the current diagnosis stale.
Recent repair attempts produced no substantive progress and the concrete failure evidence should be re-examined.
avoid_when: No concrete failure, rejection, or conflicting execution evidence is available.
The current diagnosis remains consistent with all visible evidence and no new evidence has appeared.
The unresolved operation is to author, apply, validate, promote, or finalize an artifact rather than analyze evidence.
supported_inputs: Fresh baseline or candidate test output and return status.
Observable rejection, validation, and no-progress evidence.
Public repository excerpts, task artifacts, and an existing diagnosis when present.
expected_outputs: A diagnosis artifact that identifies the failure mechanism and cites observable evidence.
Repair constraints or uncertainties grounded in evidence, without a source patch or routing instruction.

role_goal: Inspect executor-visible source, tests, and failure evidence, then produce the smallest justified unified diff that addresses the current defect.
use_when: Concrete failure evidence supports a source change and no applicable candidate patch currently exists.
A previous candidate was rejected or failed validation and observable feedback supports a materially revised patch.
Bounded source inspection can resolve the exact edit needed to create an applicable candidate.
avoid_when: An applied candidate patch is awaiting a fresh validation result.
A candidate is already verified or has been promoted to a downstream artifact.
The same repair approach is repeating without new evidence or a substantive state change.
There is no concrete failure evidence on which to ground a source modification.
supported_inputs: Executor-visible repository files, tests, and task artifacts.
Fresh test results and an evidence-grounded diagnosis when available.
Observable patch rejection or candidate validation feedback.
expected_outputs: A minimal repository-grounded unified diff submitted to the patch validator.
An applied candidate patch artifact, or an explicit evidence-grounded inability to produce one.

role_goal: Execute the public regression contract against the current applied candidate and record a fresh validation result tied to that candidate.
use_when: A candidate patch is applied and has no fresh validation result.
The applied candidate changed after the most recent validation result.
Completion claims require concrete regression evidence for the current candidate.
avoid_when: No candidate patch is currently applied.
The current candidate already has a fresh validation result and has not changed.
The observed problem is checkout preparation, diagnosis, source modification, promotion, or finalization.
supported_inputs: An applied candidate patch and its identity.
Executor-visible regression contract, runtime, and designated test targets.
expected_outputs: A fresh candidate test record linked to the current patch.
Concrete pass, fail, or environment-error evidence without modifying the candidate.

role_goal: Optional deliverable packaging after fresh validation. Promote a candidate into the downstream workflow artifact only when fresh public evidence verifies that exact candidate.
use_when: The current candidate has a fresh passing regression result and has not yet been promoted.
A downstream verified artifact is required and all visible promotion preconditions are satisfied.
avoid_when: No applied candidate or no fresh passing result exists.
The passing result refers to a different or stale candidate.
A verified downstream artifact already exists for the current candidate.
The task already has fresh passing candidate validation and no additional packaging is requested; STOP is sufficient.
supported_inputs: An applied candidate patch and matching fresh passing validation record.
Observable promotion requirements and existing downstream artifact state.
expected_outputs: A verified downstream patch artifact linked to the candidate and passing test evidence.

role_goal: Optional deliverable packaging after fresh validation. Commit a verified downstream patch as the final deliverable when the visible workflow requirements are satisfied and no unresolved blocker remains.
use_when: A verified downstream patch exists and the final deliverable has not been committed.
Visible completion requirements are satisfied and no unresolved issue blocks commitment.
avoid_when: The candidate is absent, unvalidated, failing, or not yet represented by a verified downstream artifact.
An unresolved issue or open requirement still requires execution work.
The final deliverable is already committed.
The task already has fresh passing candidate validation and no additional packaging is requested; STOP is sufficient.
supported_inputs: A verified downstream patch with matching fresh validation evidence.
Observable open requirements, issues, and final artifact state.
expected_outputs: A committed final deliverable referencing the verified patch and its validation evidence.
